comparison.objective: Feed a flash-card pouch through a laminator sealed edge first and square; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Planar sheet orientation and controlled handoff to powered rollers versus long rigid-part leveling, compliant insertion, telescoping adjustment, and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Requires correct first-bite edge/heading, roller takeover, and no late gripping; candidate requires complete prong retention, correct rack registration, prescribed screws, and release.
comparison.reason: Both require orientation recognition, but the contact mechanics and tested outcome are unrelated.
